legal.contact.intro: Questions about Aqdi, your account or a payment? Email us and we usually reply within two working days.
legal.contact.whoBody: Aqdi is software for real estate offices in Saudi Arabia, founded and run by Abdulhadi Almomen.
legal.contact.helpBody: Setting up your office and importing contracts, billing, refunds and cancelling, and requests to see or delete your data.
legal.refunds.title: Refunds and cancellation
legal.refunds.intro: Aqdi is a yearly subscription, priced per unit and paid upfront. Tenants never pay anything.
legal.refunds.1.p: If you ask within 14 days of any payment, whether your first subscription or a renewal, we refund it in full. Email us from the address on your account.
legal.refunds.2.p: It goes back to the card you paid with, through Stripe. It usually shows within 5 to 10 working days, depending on your bank.
legal.refunds.3.p: After 14 days from a payment, we don't give partial refunds for the rest of the year.
legal.refunds.4.p: You can cancel any time by emailing us. Cancelling stops the next renewal; your office stays on the paid plan until the end of the year you paid for, and your data stays.
legal.refunds.5.p: The subscription renews automatically each year on the same card, based on your number of units at renewal, unless you cancel before then.
legal.terms.title: Terms of use
legal.terms.intro: These terms cover your office's use of Aqdi. By using it, you agree to them.
legal.terms.1.p: Aqdi is software that helps real estate offices manage buildings, units, tenants and contracts, maintenance, tasks and costs, and communication with tenants.
legal.terms.2.p: Your office is responsible for its users, for the accuracy of what it enters, and for keeping passwords safe.
legal.terms.3.p: Your office's data belongs to your office. You are responsible for having the right to upload contracts and tenant details. We never sell your data.
legal.terms.4.p: AI reads your contracts and can make mistakes. That's why you review and approve each contract before it's saved, and your office is responsible for the saved details.
legal.terms.5.p: The subscription is yearly and priced per unit, in Saudi riyals, excluding VAT. It renews automatically unless you cancel, and refunds follow the Refund Policy.
legal.terms.6.p: Aqdi is not part of or connected to Ejar. Contracts and rent payments stay in Ejar.
legal.terms.7.p: Don't use Aqdi for anything unlawful, upload data you have no right to use, or try to access other offices' data.
legal.terms.8.p: We work to keep Aqdi available and secure, but it's provided as is. We're not liable for indirect losses, and our total liability is limited to what your office paid in the last 12 months.
legal.terms.9.p: We may update these terms. If a change is significant, we'll email you before it takes effect.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
legal.privacy.intro: We protect your office's and your tenants' data and handle it in line with Saudi Arabia's Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL).
legal.privacy.1.p: Account details: name, email and office name, with the password stored as a secure hash. From contracts you upload: tenant name, nationality and mobile, only the last 4 digits of the ID or iqama, and the unit, dates, rent and installments.
legal.privacy.2.p: We don't keep the contract file after reading it, or the full ID number, and we never see card numbers: payments happen at Stripe.
legal.privacy.3.p: We use providers only to run the service: Vercel for hosting, Neon for the database, Anthropic to read contracts with AI, and Stripe for payments. We don't sell data or use it for advertising.
legal.privacy.4.p: We use one cookie to keep you signed in and one to remember your language. No advertising or tracking cookies.
legal.privacy.5.p: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data at any time by emailing us. We keep data while your office's account is active and delete it on request.
